description: This file defines the ShoppingCartModelPopulator class which is responsible for converting ShoppingCartData objects into ShoppingCart model entities. It interacts with various services to manage shopping cart items, including creating, updating, and retrieving cart information within an e-commerce context.

classes.name: ShoppingCartModelPopulator
classes.description: A service class that populates a ShoppingCart entity from ShoppingCartData, including managing cart items and attributes, and interacting with related services.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts ShoppingCartData into a ShoppingCart model, updating existing cart or creating a new one, and synchronizing cart items and attributes.

methods.name: createCartItem
methods.description: Creates a ShoppingCartItem entity from a ShoppingCartItem DTO, attaching product and attribute details.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ShoppingCart instance.
